name: spot-eth/eth-venue-premium
title: ETH venue premium — Coinbase ETH-USD vs Binance ETHUSDT dislocation timer
description: The Coinbase ETH-USD price relative to Binance ETHUSDT, z-scored against its trailing 30 days of hourly bars, is traded as a hysteresis state machine (long once z > 0, flat once z < −1.5) and sized by a 50-day trend filter and a 40% inverse-EWMA-vol scalar. A pre-registered port of spot-btc/coinbase-premium with every parameter unchanged; the driver is USDT/USD demand in the Binance leg.
live_notes: SIM BOOK, NOT VENUE. A long/flat spot-crypto strategy that belongs on the testnet, but the venue pool was fully subscribed (10000/10000 USDT across four strategies) at deployment. It is a SimBroker marked to REAL Binance spot last price (quotes=binance-public): no order book, no rejection, no partial fill. Weaker evidence than the venue sleeves. It can be moved to the venue if a venue sleeve is retired.

Costs match the research exactly: fee 10 bp/side, slippage 0 in the runner. The report's cost ladder is 0 bp 1.67 / 5 bp 1.52 / 10 bp 1.38 / 20 bp 1.08 / 30 bp 0.79 (full sample). A dashboard flatten rebuilds the broker from this file with the default 1 bp slippage, so that one trade costs 1 bp more.

Overlap. Daily-return correlation is 0.85 with the live spot-eth/eth-trend-filter and 0.60 with the live spot-btc/coinbase-premium, and the ETH and BTC premium states agree 91% of hours. The report calls this an upgrade of the ETH trend sleeve, not an independent edge; running both roughly doubles one ETH-long exposure. A USDT/USD regime change hits this sleeve and the BTC premium sleeve together.

Second data feed. The premium needs Coinbase ETH-USD hourly candles from api.exchange.coinbase.com, refreshed by the runner into data/COINBASE_ETHUSD_1h.parquet. If Coinbase falls more than 3 h behind Binance the runner raises rather than trading a frozen premium; a single missing bar makes z NaN and the hysteresis state carries over, per the spec.
Execution speed matters in-sample: an extra 1 h of delay costs ~0.15 of full-sample Sharpe (OOS unaffected, 1.55), 3 h costs ~0.3. The runner rebalances 20 s after each UTC hour.
Turnover: Σ|Δw| ≈ 76/yr at 0.23 average exposure. Turnover well above that means the state machine is chattering and the Coinbase feed should be checked first.
History window: 9000 hourly bars. The live weight matches the full-history weight to 8.5e-7 over the last 720 bars at that window (6000 bars: 2.3e-5; 3000: 3.1e-3).
